ashley: FYI seeing a perf regression on Mixtral-8B after the kernel-selector change. ~20% higher p95 for gen when head_dim=48. Repro on Dedicated pool 3.

matt: hmm. 48 head dim isn't a multiple of 8/16 — does the selector try FlashAttention and then fall back to SDPA/Triton?

ashley: runtime logs show: KERNEL_CHECK: flash_attention incompatible (head_dim % 8 != 0) -> using sdpa_triton_fallback. Happened across several runs, both single and small-batch.

liyah: SDPA on Triton/CUDA can be slower for these shapes, especially with small batch or when KV cache gets reallocated. Any sign of repeated cache reallocs or memcpy spikes? :thinking:

devon: can you paste the profiler output? interested in kernel time vs memcpy and any kernel-launch stalls.

ashley: ```text
profiler summary:
model: mixtral-8b
head_dim: 48
batch: 1
seq_len: 1024
kernel selection: flash_attention -> incompatible
fallback: sdpa_triton
time breakdown (p95):
  sdpa_triton_kernel: 12.3ms
  memcpy_h2d: 1.2ms
  memcpy_d2h: 0.4ms
  host_overhead: 0.6ms
reference (head_dim=64): flash_triton_kernel: 9.8ms, memcpy_total: 0.3ms
```

infra-bot: created ticket INF-3242: "mixtral head_dim=48 sdpa fallback perf regression" (assignee: matt).

matt: thanks. Two quick questions: 1) are RoPE scaling factors different for this checkpoint? 2) is KV cache layout using packed/unaligned tensors causing extra mem copies?

ashley: RoPE scaling looks standard (1.0). KV layout is the default; we do reallocate when cached_seq + new_seq > capacity, so for long streaming sessions we see occasional reallocs. But regression reproduces on single-shot gen too.

anka: idea — add small-vec packing path in kernel selector: if head_dim % 8 != 0 try a Flash-like kernel that pads to next multiple in-register and unpacks on output to avoid SDPA slower path. Might be faster than current SDPA fallback in many cases.

matt: yes. We can: (A) add a relaxed_flash option that allows packing/unpacking, (B) add shape-based heuristic: prefer flash when batch>=2 or seq>=512 for padded pack cost amortization, (C) fallback to SDPA for tiny seq/batches.

sre-bot: scheduled canary run on dedicated-pool-3 for 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC (ticket INF-3242).

devon: to iterate faster, can we get a minimal repro script? ashley, can you share the exact run command (model artifact + flags)?

ashley: repro command: `./bench/run_infer --model mixtral-8b --head-dim 48 --seq-len 1024 --batch 1 --tokens 2048 --trace /tmp/mixtral48.trace` and trace: s3://redwood-perf/traces/mixtral48/1799876543.trace

matt: i'll prototype selector changes and a micro-benchmark comparing: flash_padded (pack/unpack) vs sdpa_triton vs flash_strict. Will open RFC/PR with perf numbers.

liyah: also add a regression test to perf CI that runs head_dim=48/56/72 shapes on mixtral/qwen to catch this.

ashley: agreed. tagging @matt @anka. thanks all, will monitor INF-3242 for canary results. :thumbsup:
